events.reason: Conditor 0.8.1 (latest) refuses echelon-current 1.16.0 for summa: the set selects Praxis 3.10.0, which declares no echelon.repository-lifecycle contract and is not a lifecycle version Conditor has qualified (it qualifies Praxis up to 3.7.2). Praxis cannot be pinned separately: Registry is the single version authority and Conditor refuses substituting a version. Needs a Conditor release that qualifies Praxis 3.10.0, or a Praxis 3.10.x that declares the lifecycle contract.
